SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT. NOT REAL LAW. Used only by automated tests.

Widget Levy Rules, Rule 12: Input credit.

A registered buyer may take input credit of the levy paid on widget purchases only when
the supplier's invoice appears in the buyer's monthly credit statement. Credit on an
invoice that does not appear in the monthly credit statement shall not be taken until it
appears. The buyer must hold the original invoice and must have received the widgets.
